title: Wikidot reference acquisition completion pointer
description: Normative framing: one UTF-8 JSON value followed by one LF, with no CR or other lines, at most 1024 bytes. stable-json-v1 follows ECMAScript JSON.stringify primitive serialization, emits non-ASCII code points as literal UTF-8, uses required JSON escapes for controls, quotation mark, and reverse solidus, applies no Unicode normalization, recursively emits object keys in Unicode code-point order with no insignificant whitespace, and preserves array order. A pointer is valid only when its attempt resolves transitively to a complete receipt for the exact work identity.
